title: Case 01: The Counterfeit Signal
fictionNotice: Fictional training case. No real token, wallet, contract, service, organisation or person is described. Nothing here checks anything in the real world.

intro.name: Market Terminal
intro.text: VENDOR NOTICE from the Market Board: registration has moved. Re-register at Relay 7 before sundown or lose your stall.

intro.name: Mini GUARD
intro.text: That notice is repeating on a loop. It looks official, but something about it is off. Let's get the facts before anyone acts on it.

npcs.name: Oren
lines: Mini GUARD! The terminal says I have to re-register at some 'Relay 7' before sundown.
I've never heard of Relay 7. But it says it's from the Market Board, so... should I just go?
The Records Board by the north wall lists everything the Board actually posts. Maybe start there.
restoredLines: The terminal only shows notices that match the Records Board now. I checked before I did anything.
Stall's open, lamps are on. Thanks for getting the facts straight.

npcs.name: Juno
lines: It looked real... but something felt off. The wording was so urgent.
Then again, I heard the Board changed its rules last week. Maybe that's why?
Who told me? Hm. I honestly can't remember.
restoredLines: Turns out nobody could back up that rumor I heard. I'll ask where things come from next time.
The East Alley is open again. Quickest way to the canal.

npcs.name: Sela
lines: I saw someone tampering with the terminal last night... well, early this morning.
Around 08:30. Grey hood. I couldn't see a face.
They walked off toward East Alley. After that the terminal started glowing violet.
restoredLines: Lamps are back on. The violet glow is gone from the alley.
I still don't know who the hooded person was. Good that the report said so plainly.

clues.name: Market Terminal
inspectLines: Header: 'Market Board, issued at the 10:00 session.'
Instruction: re-register at Relay 7 before sundown.

clues.name: Records Board
inspectLines: Market Board log: today's session opened at 10:00.
Notices posted today: 'Lamp repairs on the canal walk.' Nothing about registration.
Relay register: Relays 1 to 6. There is no Relay 7.

clues.name: Signal Trail
inspectLines: A violet signal trace runs along the stones from the terminal.
It passes under the East Alley gate and keeps going.

source.title: Terminal notice
source.body: Claims to come from the Market Board's 10:00 session. Broadcast stamp: 08:40. Says: re-register at Relay 7 before sundown.

record.title: Records Board
record.body: Board session opened 10:00. No registration notice in its log. Relay register lists 1-6; no Relay 7.

witness.title: Sela's statement
witness.body: Saw someone in a grey hood at the terminal around 08:30, then walking toward East Alley.

trail.title: Signal trail
trail.body: A violet trace runs from the terminal into East Alley.

rumor.title: Juno's rumor
rumor.body: 'I heard the Board changed its rules last week.' Juno can't say who said it.

links.text: Contradiction: the 08:40 broadcast is older than the 10:00 session it claims to come from.
Supports: the witness and the trail both point to East Alley.
Supports: the trail starts at the terminal that sent the notice.
Supports: the trail heads toward a relay the public register doesn't list.
Supports: someone was at the terminal at 08:30, ten minutes before the 08:40 broadcast.

unrelatedText: No shared time, actor or place connects these two.
rumorLinkText: Nothing on the board backs this claim. You can't link it to evidence. Mark it Uncertain instead.

uncertainWrongText.source: You read this on the terminal yourself. The stamp and header are observed.
uncertainWrongText.record: You read the Records Board yourself.
uncertainWrongText.witness: Sela said this to you directly. Who she saw is unknown, but her statement is real.

boardObjectives.text: Expose the contradiction in the notice
Link evidence that points to one place
Mark what nobody can verify as Uncertain

boardHints: Compare the times. When was the notice broadcast, and when did the session it names begin?
Where do the witness and the trail each lead?
Which card has no source you could check? Use its 'Uncertain' button.
conclusion: The notice claims a source that didn't exist yet when it was broadcast.
The witness and the trail both lead to East Alley, toward a relay that no record lists.
The relay is reacting. A Spoof Swarm is spreading into the market lanes!

containment.intro: Spoof signals are pouring out of East Alley. Citizens are heading for shelter. Hold the Shield in their lane. Raise it just as a signal arrives to reflect it.

authorize.prompt: Authorization node. The Proton Key opens only the route your evidence supports. Which route?
authorize.granted: Authorized. The evidence supports East Alley, and the gate opens.
authorize.withheld: Authorization withheld. None of your evidence points to this route.

relay.name: Unregistered relay
inspectLines: A relay with no register number. It rebroadcasts the notice under a borrowed 'Market Board' header.
The trail ends here. With the route verified, the relay goes quiet and the counterfeit notice stops repeating.

findings.text: The 08:40 broadcast stamp is earlier than the 10:00 session it cites.
findings.why: You compared the terminal stamp with the Records Board log.

findings.text: 'Relay 7' is not in the public relay register.
A signal trail runs from the terminal into East Alley.
findings.why: You followed and inspected the trail.

findings.text: The notice pushes vendors with a sundown deadline.
findings.why: Urgent deadlines are a warning sign, but not proof on their own.

findings.text: The notice sends vendors to a place no record lists.
findings.why: An unlisted destination deserves caution before anyone goes there.

findings.text: Who the grey-hooded person at the terminal was.
findings.why: One witness saw them. Nobody identified them.

findings.text: The rumor that the Board changed its rules last week.
findings.why: No record or source backs it up.

findings.text: Ask the Market Board office directly whether it sent any notice today.
findings.why: Going to the claimed source directly is the next check.

findings.text: Compare any terminal notice with the Records Board before acting.
findings.why: A habit every vendor can repeat.
